items.title: Mike Longo interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2019
items.q: It wasn’t his band, I was just a sideman, he was too. It was the Harold Ferguson Band.

ctx.x: Yeah. And so I hired him for the gig, and as soon as he walked on the bandstand, the street was all filled. It was a street dance. There was a big hush that came over the audience you know. But as soon as he started playing “The Stars Fell on Alabama” it melted everybody’s heart and everybody started dancing. And so then my dad started using him on all the club dates. And then Cannonball got me a gig on an R&B band, what do you call it, we used to play the Chitlin Circuit, up and down the coast of Florida. It…
